## Description

A low domed vehicle has two round wheels and a large circular side window crossed by a horizontal divider. A small beacon rises from the roof beneath two pairs of radiating arcs.

## Component preparation

Side combination; do not draw the complete source as one solo.

Main: A low semicircular domed vehicle with two circular wheels, a large round side window with a horizontal divider, and a small rounded physical beacon mounted on the roof. Draw the vehicle and attached beacon alone; exclude the detached wireless-wave arcs above it. Simplify the window divider if needed for native-size clearance.
